    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_1" sourceRef="Employee_OrderReceived" targetRef="Employee_EnterOrder"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_6" sourceRef="Employee_InformChef" targetRef="Employee_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_7" sourceRef="Employee_MealReady" targetRef="Employee_SetOffBuzzer"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_10" sourceRef="Employee_FiveMinuteTimer" targetRef="Employee_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_11" sourceRef="Employee_CallGuest" targetRef="Employee_CallComplete"/>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealOrder" name="Meal order"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Restaurant">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Guest orders and collects a meal" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Guest_Hungry" name="Feels hungry"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_3" sourceRef="Guest_ChooseDish" targetRef="Guest_WaitTurn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_4" sourceRef="Guest_WaitTurn" targetRef="Guest_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_5" sourceRef="Guest_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Guest_BuzzerReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_6" sourceRef="Guest_BuzzerReceived" targetRef="Guest_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_7" sourceRef="Guest_BuzzerRings" targetRef="Guest_AppearAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_8" sourceRef="Guest_AppearAtHatch" targetRef="Guest_MealHandedOver"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_10" sourceRef="Guest_PickUpMeal" targetRef="Guest_EatMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_11" sourceRef="Guest_EatMeal" targetRef="Guest_Finished"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Employee handles order and meal collection" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Employee_OrderReceived" name="Meal order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Employee_OrderReceived_Definition" messageRef="Message_MealOrder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Employee_EnterOrder" name="Enter order into the POS system"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Employee_SetUpBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Employee_PassBuzzer" name="Pass buzzer and say: "When the buzzer rings, your dinner is ready"" messageRef="Message_BuzzerAndInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Employee_InformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order" messageRef="Message_ChefOrder"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Employee_MealReady" name="Become aware meal is ready">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Employee_MealReady_Definition" messageRef="Message_MealReady"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Employee_SetOffBuzzer" name="Set off guest's buzzer" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Employee_WaitForGuestOrTimer" name="Wait for guest or 5 minutes"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Employee_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest appears at the service hatch">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Employee_GuestAtHatch_Definition" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Employee_FiveMinutes" name="5 minutes pass">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="Employee_FiveMinutes_Definition">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">PT5M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Employee_CallGuest" name="Call for guest"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Employee_HandOverMeal" name="Hand meal over to guest" messageRef="Message_MealHandover"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Employee_OrderComplete" name="Meal handed over"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_1" sourceRef="Employee_OrderReceived" targetRef="Employee_EnterOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_2" sourceRef="Employee_EnterOrder" targetRef="Employee_CollectMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_3" sourceRef="Employee_CollectMoney" targetRef="Employee_SetUpBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_4" sourceRef="Employee_SetUpBuzzer" targetRef="Employee_PassBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_5" sourceRef="Employee_PassBuzzer" targetRef="Employee_InformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_6" sourceRef="Employee_InformChef" targetRef="Employee_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_7" sourceRef="Employee_MealReady" targetRef="Employee_SetOffBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_8" sourceRef="Employee_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Employee_WaitForGuestOrTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_9" sourceRef="Employee_WaitForGuestOrTimer" targetRef="Employee_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_10" sourceRef="Employee_WaitForGuestOrTimer" targetRef="Employee_FiveMinutes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_11" sourceRef="Employee_GuestAtHatch" targetRef="Employee_HandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_12" sourceRef="Employee_FiveMinutes" targetRef="Employee_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Employee_Flow_13" sourceRef="Employee_CallGuest" targetRef="Employee_WaitForGuestOrTimer"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Chef_Flow_1" sourceRef="Chef_OrderReceived" targetRef="Chef_PrepareMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Chef_Flow_2" sourceRef="Chef_PrepareMeal" targetRef="Chef_PlaceMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Chef_Flow_3" sourceRef="Chef_PlaceMeal" targetRef="Chef_InformMealReady"/>

rules.instruction: When the description states that one step follows another without describing a branch or synchronization at that point: Connect the steps directly rather than inserting a gateway with one incoming and one outgoing sequence flow.
rules.situation: the description states that one step follows another without describing a branch or synchronization at that point

rules.instruction: When the description states a sequence of activities or a conditional step followed by a later activity: Connect the activities and any modeled gateways in the stated order with sequence flows, including every described transition.
rules.situation: the description states distinct process steps or events in temporal order

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes an event or activity by its action, actor, object, recipient, or another meaningful qualifier: Label each BPMN element so that it preserves those stated details without substituting a broader or different meaning.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes an event or activity by its action, actor, object, recipient, or another meaningful qualifier

rules.instruction: When the description states that one participant’s described activity or occurrence communicates information or an item to another participant: Model the described activity or occurrence itself as the appropriate message-flow endpoint: use a task for performed work and an event for an occurrence. Do not add a separate send task merely to carry the same communication.
rules.situation: the description states that one participant’s described activity or occurrence communicates information or an item to another participant

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly orders process steps, including steps separated by a waiting condition or event: Connect the corresponding BPMN elements with sequence flows in the described order, keeping any intervening events in the flow.
rules.situation: the description explicitly orders process steps, including steps separated by a waiting condition or event

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant performs a distinct action between other steps: Model the action as its own activity and connect it to the preceding and following steps with sequence flows in the described order.
rules.situation: the description states that a participant performs a distinct action between other steps

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes a process trigger, an activity, or an outcome from other stages of the process: Label each BPMN element according to the meaning of its corresponding described trigger, activity, or outcome; do not substitute a different stage or its purpose or result.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes a process trigger, an activity, or an outcome from other stages of the process
